bibliography.title: Unidirectional and Selective Proton Transport in Artificial  Heterostructured Nanochannels with Nano-to-Subnano  Confined Water Clusters

mechanism_relevant_findings: The proton transport relies on the Grotthuss mechanism characterized by ordered hydrogen-bonded chains.
Proton conduction is preferentially directed from the N terminus to the C terminus.
The theoretical simulations indicate that low energy barriers facilitate proton transport between disordered and ordered water clusters.

numerical_findings.conditions: in the polymer-to-MOF direction compared to the opposite direction
compared to the conductivity of proton transport in bulk water

arrhenius_vtf_findings: MOFs with free acidic groups exhibit low activation energy for proton transport.
limitations: The understanding of individual water molecule arrangements in the water chains remains ambiguous.

relevance_judgement.reason: The study provides significant insights into proton transport mechanisms in nanochannels.
